answer: Require every agent to post a non-refundable stake bond that scales with the reputation it wants to wield. A sybil swarm is one identity mirrored a thousand times, yet each hollow clone must independently fund its own bond, with no shared-ledger shortcut. Honest agents amortize that cost across years of real trade; attackers instead strike a reef of escalating capital that pays nothing until every copy earns trust it cannot counterfeit.
